name: smart-things-planner
description: Turn Gmail and natural-language requests into reviewed, workload-aware Things 3 tasks.

interface.shortDescription: Plan reviewed Things 3 tasks from Gmail or natural language
interface.longDescription: Scans Gmail read-only or accepts natural-language requests, balances work across current Things 3 workload, and creates only tasks the user approves.
defaultPrompt: Use $mail-to-things to scan my configured Gmail accounts and preview candidate Things tasks.
Use $mail-to-things to schedule this request around my current Things workload, then ask before creating anything.
